title: Optimizer candidate and promotion safety
description:
Purpose: Ensure optimizer candidates are mechanically valid, compared against the correct incumbent, and supported by sufficient evidence before promotion can be recommended.

Exclusions:
- Client-specific rubric judgments.
- Automatic production promotion without the established approval gate.
- Replacing the canonical evaluator.

Dependencies: Uses frozen cohort and provenance contracts from the reproducible-cohorts epic. Most mechanical validation can proceed independently.

Definition of Done:
- Class collapse, invalid output classes, broken inter-node dataflow, unsafe dry-run writes, and unintended model changes fail closed.
- Candidate and synthesis selection compare against the current leader on identical cohorts.
- Promotion evidence includes validation outcomes, cohort identity, metrics, and explicit unresolved risks.
- Behavior-first specifications and focused tests pass.

Running log: Record sanitized decisions, attempts, outcomes, and next steps in this epic or its child issues.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Synthesis-safety implementation is underway in an isolated worktree. Scope: compare proposed synthesis with the current cycle leader on identical recent and regression cohorts; reject negative deltas; keep the selected model pinned unless a reviewed justification permits change; retain the human promotion approval gate. Next: establish a failing observable specification, implement the minimum compatible change, then run focused tests.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented synthesis safety with behavior-first specifications. Outcome: synthesis strategy scoring and final carry-forward now use the current cycle leader; any negative leader-relative recent or regression delta is rejected. Recent feedback IDs and regression dataset identity are checked before comparison. The reviewer receives the leader-relative basis and cohort identifiers. Synthesis pins the score model unless reviewed_model_change_justification is supplied. Human promotion approval remains outside the optimizer. Validation: focused configuration suite passed (80 tests) and the procedure Lua body compiled. Next: commit this scoped change for integration.
